sourceNotes: Preliminary gear design rules summarized from public machine design references. Final design needs the project standard, material, heat treatment, and contact/bending strength calculations.
rules: Define power, input speed, output speed, service factor, and transmission ratio before choosing module.
Use standard modules and pressure angles unless the project explicitly requires custom tooling.
Check bending strength, contact stress, shaft center distance, bearing reactions, lubrication, and enclosure.
Avoid very small tooth counts without profile shift because undercut and weak teeth become likely.
Gear outputs must include module, teeth count, pressure angle, face width, material, heat treatment, accuracy grade, and lubrication note.
